work_completed: Diagnosed the published asfdk 0.3.0 wheel: importing asfdk raised ImportError because nlt_toi 1.0.0 does not ship TOIDocumentGenerator (inlined by PR #31)

Added src/asfdk/toi_bootstrap.py: uses the pillar's TOIDocumentGenerator when present, else a verbatim canonical DEFAULT_DOCUMENT fallback that is still validated through nlt_toi.parse_toi (fail-loud preserved); foundation.get_system_status() surfaces which source was used

Fixed integration/sleepwalker.py to mirror the real pillar EmotionalState fields (state_type, protective, requires_check_in, confidence, explicit_suicidal_ideation, ...) via EmotionalStateWithProvenance instead of the nonexistent .state/.raw_scores accessors
Added sanitize-then-assess flow with fail-open detection and flag provenance (flagged/flag_reason) to the Sleepwalker adapter
Added D5 gate-up predicate in foundation.py (untrusted channel + high-severity crisis signal) and an error boundary so an RRT failure cannot abort crisis/emergency routing
Added top-level channel provenance (D2/D4) on UserInteraction in types.py; trust is read only from the top-level channel field
Added tests/test_provenance.py (provenance propagation, gate-up, pillar-correct fields); full suite 59 passed
Bumped version to 0.3.1 (pyproject.toml + __init__.py) and regenerated packages/asfdk/package-lock.json for @neurolift-technologies/toi ^1.0.3 (the blocker recorded in THREAD-011)

Built dist/asfdk-0.3.1-py3-none-any.whl and .tar.gz with python -m build; installed the wheel into a clean venv (pulling nlt-toi 1.0.0, nlt-otoi 1.2.0, rrt-advocate 0.1.1, sleepwalker-protocol 1.0.1 from PyPI) and ran end-to-end probes against the installed wheel — all passed
decisions_made: TOI generator fallback mirrors the TypeScript canonical DEFAULT_DOCUMENT but always validates through the pillar's parser before activation — fail-loud guarantee from THREAD-011 is preserved (no silent fallback)
Trust derivation stays additive: absent channel resolves to unknown/untrusted; nested data/context values are never consulted for trust
Release executed as fix commits on fix/0.3.1-pypi-release rather than a bare version-bump release branch, because the code fixes are the substance of 0.3.1
decisions_pending: Actual PyPI upload for 0.3.1 (twine) — owner: Joshua W. Dorsey, Sr.
